IC1: Be categorized as American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Physical Status Class 1 [OR], 2 [OR], or 3.
IC2: Have a planned non-emergent surgical procedure [OR] or clinical situation (e.g., intubation) that requires moderate [OR] or deep NMB with either rocuronium [OR] or vecuronium.
IC3: Have a planned surgical procedure [OR] or clinical situation that would allow objective neuromuscular monitoring techniques to be applied with access to the arm for neuromuscular transmission monitoring.
IC4: Age between 2 to <17 years at Visit 2.
IC5: If female, may participate if she is [NOT] not pregnant, [NOT] not breastfeeding, and at least one of the following: 1) [NOT] Not a woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP) [OR]; or 2) A WOCBP who agrees to follow the study contraceptive guidance during the treatment period [OR] and for at least 7 days after the last dose of study treatment.
